topic: Tortma nega taqillab yopiladi — yumshoq yopiluvchi yo'naltiruvchi
style: Photorealistic, vertical 9:16, cinematic soft daylight, shallow depth of field, modern Central Asian home, natural realistic movement, no on-screen text.

shots.prompt: A young Central Asian man in a casual sweater in a modern kitchen with dark green cabinets pushes a kitchen drawer shut too hard, the drawer slams loudly and the dishes inside rattle; he winces and looks annoyed. Medium shot.
shots.say: Oshxonadagi tortmalaringiz taqillab yopiladimi? Idishlar ichida shaqillab ketadimi?

shots.prompt: Close-up of an experienced furniture craftsman's hands in a clean workshop installing a concealed soft-close full-extension drawer runner (metal slide rail) under a light wooden drawer box with a screwdriver. Detailed, sharp focus on the metal runner mechanism.
shots.say: Sababi yo'naltiruvchida. Yashirin, yumshoq yopiluvchi yo'naltiruvchi tortma ostiga o'rnatiladi.

shots.prompt: A smiling young Central Asian woman in a bright modern kitchen gives a kitchen drawer a light push with one hand; the drawer slows down near the end and closes gently and silently by itself. Close-up on the drawer front, then her calm smile.
shots.say: Tortmani biroz itarsangiz, oxirida o'zi sekinlab, jimgina yopiladi.

shots.prompt: A furniture craftsman in a workshop apron pulls out a wide kitchen drawer full of heavy pots and pans; it slides out smoothly all the way to full extension without sagging. He nods confidently at the camera.
shots.say: Sifatli yo'naltiruvchi og'ir kastryullarni ham ko'taradi va tortma to'liq ochiladi.

cta.say: Yumshoq yopiluvchi yo'naltiruvchilar Furnipart premiumda. Marg'ilon. O'zbekiston bo'ylab dastavka bor. Direktga yozing!
